target: Ableton Live 12 Suite 12.4.3 (2026-07-07_e3d8be4d07), macOS host only
common_prerequisites: Pin the Live executable and preferences hash; fresh preferences; 48 kHz, 24-bit export with dither off and normalization off; Main and Cue at 0 dB

probes.question: Is the track at its stored minimum gain (Volume Manual 0.0003162277571, display "-inf dB") exactly silent in the output, and is a stored gain just above the 0.00032 floor audible at its dB value?
probes.existing_evidence: 0x101aede40 and 0x101aee5e8: gain <= 0.00032 (0x39a7c5ac) becomes 0 after the curve; derive_curves.py
probes.why_static_insufficient: The logic-to-engine value of the Volume port (normalized position, inferred) was not traced; audio output needs measurement
probes.minimal_input: Recording Audio.als (App-Resources/Core Library/Lessons/Sets, SHA-256 af57ff8f9eb1c2c51220ef6633a58838532350d53640df5f48dc01659023c043, MinorVersion 12.0_12402), decompressed, edited as stated, recompressed with gzip, plus one audio track playing a mono, full-scale 1 kHz test tone clip (to be generated on the analysis host and hashed before the sitting; not a shipped file); track Volume Manual variants 0.0003162277571, 0.000323594 (-69.8 dB), 0.001 (-60 dB), 1
probes.discriminating_observation: Export Audio (or a recorded resampling track) peak and RMS: exact digital zero for the minimum; -69.8 dB and -60 dB within 0.05 dB of the tone level minus the stored dB
